captions.text: Open an existing project folder. This is the actual Axocoatl 1.5.3 dashboard in Dark mode.
Create a session in the workspace. Navigation gaps are removed from this edited recording.
Set a local GPT-OSS 20B lead, required npm tests, and a read-only Qwen3-Coder 30B reviewer.
Preview and apply the team. These are the actual models and checks used for the task.
Ask for the pagination fix, preserve existing tests, and add boundary regressions. Do not commit.
The lead works on the files. Waiting footage plays four times faster; all captured samples remain.
The agent graph shows the lead and required reviewer. The first review does not succeed.
Qwen returned malformed tool calls twice. The first turn needs attention; it is kept as a partial result.
The first patch also replaced an existing test. The partial result and its failed-review receipt are retained.
An offscreen model-configuration change was attempted. This Session kept its frozen Qwen reviewer.
A corrective request restores the original test and asks for separate boundary regressions.
The lead corrects the tests. Waiting footage is accelerated four times.
The host runs the required checks and review for the corrective turn.
Required review continues against the changed files. Waiting footage is accelerated four times.
The actual frozen reviewer is still Qwen3-Coder 30B. The attempted configuration change did not apply here.
Qwen reviews in round two. This is the same recorded corrective turn, with the earlier failure preserved.
The host check passes, and Qwen approves in round two of two. The corrective turn completes.
Download the signed receipt for this turn. It records observed checks, review, and covered file hashes.
This receipt covers the corrective turn's test file. It does not cover the whole session or prove the change correct.
Inspect the pagination source diff in Files. The earlier partial turn produced this source change.
Inspect the test diff: the original tests remain and separate boundary regressions are present.
Download the final turn receipt. The first turn's source/test receipt is also retained in the evidence.
